content: Well, that's really disappointing; in the video you advertised the new cover; but apparently it's only if you buy a new one? :-(
I thought we were getting the hinged top cover? Also wasnt there a revised version of the top vent?

The upgrade kit doesn't include the new top cover.

"When you buy a brand new CORE One+ Gen2 3D printer (assembled or kit), it also features the same top cover as the CORE One L - the main difference is that this top cover is easier to remove. This top cover is not included in the upgrade kit, as it does not affect the performance of the machine and would increase the shipping costs. However, it can be purchased separately as a spare part - we'll add it to the spare part section in the upcoming days."
Where's the new easy to remove top cover? Same as before, but two rivets?
